formulas.ascii: Initialize r=1/max(N,1). Each round: D=sum(r[u] for outDegree[u]=0); provisional[v]=(1-d)/N+d*(sum(r[u]/outDegree[u] over incoming edges)+D/N); S=sum(provisional); r[v]=provisional[v]/S. Overflow publishes zero; normalization also publishes zero unless S>0, S=S and abs(S)<=3.402823466e38. Optional final residual=sum(abs(new-old)), or zero on overflow/invalid S. Float32 reductions; edge multiplicity is preserved, weights are ignored.
